audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Gragas four of seven stages including both item stages, while you win the matchup 54.94% and the page's own late-game prose says you out-scale him outright. The packet flags this as a data contradiction.
audit.why: The mirror audit on gragas__vladimir already settled and applied Vladimir / Gragas / Skill / Vladimir / Gragas / Skill / Vladimir: you own level 1 because Transfusion is free while Barrel Roll costs 80 mana, he owns level 2 and the level-6 Cask window, and you take the late game.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown appeared anywhere despite Body Slam being named the matchup-defining tracker.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 and is his only gap-closer, so baiting it buys a full 14 seconds at rank 1. Your Transfusion drops from 9s to 4.6s by rank 5, which is why levels 4-5 swing to you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanics were never stated: Barrel Roll's potency increases the longer the cask sits before detonation (up to 4 seconds), and Drunken Rage is a 5-second auto-attack reset that also reduces the damage Gragas takes.
audit.why: Both come straight from Riot's text. They change when you fight: never stand on an aging barrel, and treat his auto wind-up after the 1-second drink as the tell rather than waiting for a cast.

Happy Hour heals him periodically on skill use, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades — report[8].t and breakdown.late already make anti-heal core and Mercury's Treads is right against his stun-heavy kit.
